name: flexigantt
description: Connect an AI agent to FlexiGantt, the Mac app for classical project management (WBS, dependencies, critical path, baselines, Gantt and roadmaps): build a new plan or import one from CSV, Excel or MS Project XML, answer questions about a live schedule, and export Gantt PDFs and Roadmap PDF/PowerPoint slides via the bundled MCP tools. Signs in with OAuth.
